heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋一張寬卡片在上、兩張左圖右文卡片並排
desc: 標題組置中在上；下方第一列是一張橫跨內容寬度、圖文與大按鈕橫向排列的寬卡片，第二列是兩張等寬的卡片，左側圖片面板貼齊卡片邊緣、右側文字與按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題組下方是對齊頁面內容寬度的多個卡片，分成兩列：第一列是一張橫跨內容寬度的寬卡片，內部橫向排成三段並垂直置中：左側一張小型橫式圖片，中間是標題（可多行），右側一顆大按鈕，約佔卡片寬度的四成，明顯大於下方卡片的按鈕。第二列是兩張等寬、等高的卡片並排，每張卡片左側是約佔卡片寬度三分之一的圖片面板，圖片面板貼齊卡片的上緣、下緣與左緣；右側文字區靠左排列標題、說明文字（可多行）與按鈕，按鈕橫跨文字區。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組維持置中在最上方，下方的卡片每列一張，依序直向排列。寬卡片內部改為直向置中，由上到下的順序是：標題、圖片、按鈕；標題在圖片上方，和桌機左側圖片、中間標題的順序不同。下方兩張卡片的圖片面板移到卡片上方，貼齊卡片的上緣與左右兩側，改為橫式；文字區在下方，依序是標題、說明文字與按鈕，按鈕橫跨文字區。

en.name: Centered heading + one wide card above two side-by-side image-left cards
en.desc: A centered heading group at the top; below it, the first row is a wide card spanning the content width with an image, text and a large button in a horizontal row, and the second row is two equal-width cards, each with an image panel flush with the card edges on the left and text and a button on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a description below; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group are multiple cards aligned to the page content width, in two rows: the first row is one wide card spanning the content width, its inside arranged horizontally in three parts, vertically centered: a small landscape image on the left, a title (may wrap to multiple lines) in the middle, and a large button on the right taking about forty percent of the card's width, clearly larger than the buttons in the cards below. The second row is two equal-width, equal-height cards side by side; each card has an image panel on the left taking about one third of the card's width, flush with the card's top, bottom and left edges; the text area on the right holds a title, a description (may wrap to multiple lines) and a button, aligned left, with the button spanning the text area.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically: the heading group stays centered at the top, and the cards below are arranged one per row in order. Inside the wide card the parts are stacked vertically and centered, in this order from top to bottom: title, image, button; the title sits above the image, unlike the desktop order of image on the left and title in the middle. In the two lower cards the image panel moves to the top of the card, flush with the card's top edge and left and right sides, and becomes landscape; the text area is below it, with the title, description and button in order, the button spanning the text area.
